summary: Completed comprehensive backend and frontend testing for Lovli AI dating coach app. Backend: 29/33 tests passed (87.9%). The 4 failed tests were due to Anthropic API 529 overload (temporary external issue), resolved by switching to Emergent provider. Frontend: Login, reply generation, copy functionality, and static pages all working correctly. Minor testid inconsistencies found but core functionality verified.

resolved_issues.impact: All reply generation requests failing with 503
resolved_issues.fix_priority: N/A - External API issue, fallback working

testid_inconsistencies.issue: Some testids don't match expected patterns
testid_inconsistencies.details: Manual text input uses 'reply-paste-textarea' instead of 'reply-manual-text'. Platform/Vibe use ChipGroup (button clicks) not Select dropdowns. Generate button is 'generate-replies-button' not 'reply-generate-button'. Reply cards use 'reply-result-card' not 'reply-card-{index}'.
testid_inconsistencies.impact: Minor - doesn't affect functionality, only test automation

testid_inconsistencies.details: Bottom nav tabs use 'bottom-nav-reply', 'bottom-nav-pro', 'bottom-nav-memory' instead of 'nav-{tab}'
